lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Bubbles!
lines.zh: 泡泡！

lines.en: Peppa and George are drinking orange juice.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在喝橙汁。

lines.en: What noisy little piggies!
lines.zh: 这两个小家伙真吵呀！

lines.en: George, look at all the tiny bubbles!
lines.zh: 乔治，快看这些小泡泡！

lines.en: I can make bigger bubbles!
lines.zh: 我能吹出更大的泡泡！

lines.en: George wants to blow bubbles, too.
lines.zh: 乔治也想吹泡泡。

lines.en: You really shouldn't play with your food! Sorry, Daddy!
lines.zh: 你们真不该拿食物来玩！对不起，爸爸！

lines.en: Peppa, if you like bubbles, why don't you play with your bubble mixture? Yes, my bubble mixture! George, let's blow bubbles in the garden!
lines.zh: 佩奇，既然你喜欢泡泡，为什么不去玩你的泡泡水呢？对呀，我的泡泡水！乔治，我们去花园里吹泡泡吧！

lines.en: Peppa is showing George how to blow bubbles. First, dip the stick in the mixture, then take a big breath and blow!
lines.zh: 佩奇在给乔治示范怎么吹泡泡。首先，把小棒蘸一下泡泡水，然后深吸一口气，吹！

lines.en: Bubble!
lines.zh: 泡泡！

lines.en: George, now it's your turn! Dip the stick in the mixture, hold it up, take a big breath, and blow!
lines.zh: 乔治，现在轮到你了！把小棒蘸一下泡泡水，举起来，深吸一口气，然后吹！

lines.en: George is trying really hard, but he is running out of breath!
lines.zh: 乔治非常努力地试了，可他的气不够用了！

lines.en: George, you didn't blow hard enough!
lines.zh: 乔治，你吹得不够用力！

lines.en: I know a way George can make bubbles! Dip the stick in the mixture, then lift it up and wave it around! It's even better if you run along!
lines.zh: 我知道一个乔治也能吹出泡泡的办法！把小棒蘸一下泡泡水，然后举起来挥来挥去！要是边跑边挥，效果更好哦！

lines.en: George is having fun making bubbles, and Peppa is having fun popping them!
lines.zh: 乔治开心地吹泡泡，佩奇开心地戳泡泡！

lines.en: I love bubbles!
lines.zh: 我喜欢泡泡！

lines.en: Oh, dear, the bubble mixture is all used up! There's no more bubble mixture! Don't worry, Peppa, I have an idea!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，泡泡水全用完了！没有泡泡水了！别担心，佩奇，我有个主意！

lines.en: Mummy Pig, bring me a bucket, please! Yes, Daddy Pig! Bring me some soap! Yes, Daddy Pig! George, bring me my old tennis racket! A bucket, some soap, a tennis racket? What is Daddy Pig doing?
lines.zh: 猪妈妈，请给我拿个水桶来！好的，猪爸爸！再给我拿点肥皂！好的，猪爸爸！乔治，把我的旧网球拍拿来！水桶、肥皂、网球拍？猪爸爸要做什么呢？

lines.en: First, I need some water!
lines.zh: 首先，我需要一些水！

lines.en: Then the soap!
lines.zh: 然后是肥皂！

lines.en: And now the tennis racket, please! Thank you! Now watch this!
lines.zh: 现在请给我网球拍！谢谢！大家看好啦！

lines.en: Wow!
lines.zh: 哇！

lines.en: Daddy Pig has made his own bubble mixture! Come on, everyone!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸自己做了一盆泡泡水！大家快来！

lines.en: Be careful, Daddy Pig, don't slip!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸小心点，别滑倒！

lines.en: Are you okay, Daddy Pig? Yes, I'm fine!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你没事吧？我没事！

lines.en: Wow! Daddy Pig has made the biggest bubble ever!
lines.zh: 哇！猪爸爸吹出了史上最大的泡泡！

lines.en: Oh, dear, I've spilled all my bubble mixture! Now we can't make any more bubbles!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，我把泡泡水全洒了！现在我们吹不出泡泡了！

lines.en: But we can play jumping in muddy puddles! Look, Daddy Pig's bubble mixture has made a big muddy puddle!
lines.zh: 不过我们还可以玩跳泥坑呀！看，猪爸爸的泡泡水弄出了一个大大的泥坑！

lines.en: Peppa loves jumping up and down in muddy puddles! Look, the bubble mixture has made the puddle all bubbly!
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下！看，泡泡水把这个水坑弄得全是泡泡！

lines.en: Peppa loves jumping up and down in muddy bubbly puddles!
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢在满是泡泡的泥坑里跳上跳下！

lines.en: Everyone loves jumping up and down in muddy bubbly puddles!
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢在满是泡泡的泥坑里跳上跳下！
